jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Corporate Strategy Group charts our course for long-term profitable growth. This team drives Lam in the development of and alignment to our strategic priorities and key initiatives. Additionally, they oversee Lam's Corporate Development team and Lam Capital, which makes investments that help fuel technologies of the future.

The impact you’ll make

As a member of the Lam Corporate Strategy team you will be responsible for driving and orchestrating projects focused on leading Lam to make the best strategic choices in support of our corporate objectives.

What you’ll do

- Take ownership of significant portions of strategy development and generate creative, action-oriented insights and recommendations.
- Facilitate joint problem-solving with mid-level and senior-level business partners.
- Distill information, gain clarity of ideas, synthesize insights, and define next steps for execution.
- Produce novel research work products, often challenging existing company strategies with new insights.
- Deliver timely and impactful recommendations, ensuring the organization is engaging in the right strategic discussions.
- Synthesize data to identify trends and insights, and proactively identify and close gaps in the collective knowledge base.
- Understand and stay current with the competitive landscape.
- Author and deliver high-impact presentations and plans to senior management.

Typical Projects Include
- Analysis of ecosystem and competitive trends to identify growth opportunities and disruptive threats.
- Development of detailed growth strategies, with sufficient depth to undergo stress testing and integration into the corporate planning process.
- Critical, insightful analyses of Lam and its ecosystem that deliver actionable strategic options.

Who we’re looking for

- Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
- Semiconductor industry experience.

- Excellence in structured thinking, with superior analytical capabilities (both quantitative and qualitative).

- Ability to identify and define business questions and issues, and develop strategic, analytical, and financial frameworks to help drive strategic debate.

- Exceptionally strong personal initiative, sound business instincts, and comfort working in environments with high levels of ambiguity.

Preferred qualifications

- Strong understanding of Lam, its ecosystem, and the trends that are and will shape its future.
- Creative, out-of-the-box thinker who is intellectually curious and demonstrates a continued interest in learning.
- Ability to manage multiple simultaneous high-priority projects, often including project management of cross-functional teams.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

jobs.title: Skills Architect Program Manager
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Human Resources Group operates on the understanding that our people are our most valuable assets. They think globally to optimize our workforce, integrate our Core Values into everything we do, and deliver the HR solutions to enhance the employee experience and enable future growth.

The impact you’ll make

The Skills Architect Program Manager is responsible for designing, governing, and continuously evolving Lam Research’s enterprise skills architecture. This role owns the structure and integrity of the skills framework, including skills taxonomy, role-based skills profiles, proficiency models, skill definitions, and relationships across jobs, learning, talent, and workforce processes.

The role combines skills architecture expertise with program management to translate workforce, business, and labor market insights into scalable skills solutions. The role leads skills validation, develops taxonomy recommendations, establishes architecture standards, and manages the implementation of approved changes across various talent and learning platforms. The role also surfaces actionable skills insights and data to identify workforce capability needs and inform broader upskilling and reskilling efforts across Lam.

What you’ll do

Skills Architecture & Governance
- Design and continuously evolve Lam’s enterprise skills architecture, including taxonomy structure, proficiency levels, definitions, relationships, and role-based skills profiles.
- Establish architecture standards and governance criteria for creating, modifying, consolidating, and retiring skills.
- Analyze business needs, workforce priorities, and labor-market trends to identify emerging, declining, and critical skills.
- Maintain the quality and integrity of the skills taxonomy by resolving duplicate, outdated, overlapping, or poorly defined skills.
- Evaluate proposed changes and recommend scalable enhancements aligned with enterprise standards and business requirements.
- Maintain architecture documentation, decision rationale, and quality controls.

Skills Program Management
- Lead enterprise skills architecture priorities and roadmap initiatives.
- Plan and facilitate skills discovery, design, and validation sessions with business and functional stakeholders.
- Translate business requirements and SME input into architecture recommendations, decisions, and implementation plans.
- Maintain the roadmap, backlog, dependencies, decision log, and implementation priorities.
- Monitor adoption, assessment, and taxonomy-health data to improve the skills framework and employee experience.
- Analyze and surface skills insights, gaps, and trends to inform enterprise upskilling and reskilling priorities.

Ecosystem Integration
- Define how enterprise skills architecture is represented across Lam, independent of any specific technology platform.
- Establish skills-mapping principles across jobs, learning content, development plans, career pathways, talent acquisition, and workforce planning.
- Partner with HRIS and technology teams to translate architecture requirements into system configurations and integrations.
- Assess the downstream impact of taxonomy changes and validate skills tagging, content mapping, recommendations, and role profiles across systems.
- Identify and resolve architecture and data inconsistencies between platforms.

What you’ll do (continued)

Stakeholder Partnership
- Serve as the enterprise subject-matter expert for skills architecture, taxonomy design, and role-based skills modeling.
- Advise HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Workforce Planning, Talent Management, Global Inclusion Learning & Development, HRIS, and business leaders on skills architecture decisions.
- Facilitate alignment between business needs, enterprise standards, governance requirements, and system constraints.
- Translate complex architecture concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive audiences.

Success Measures
- Quality, consistency, and scalability of the enterprise skills architecture
- Accuracy and relevance of skills taxonomy and role-based profiles
- Successful implementation and adoption of approved architecture enhancements
- Alignment of skills across talent, learning, career, and workforce processes
- Timely delivery of roadmap priorities, architecture decisions, and actionable skills insights that inform upskilling, reskilling, and workforce capability priorities

Who we’re looking for

- Minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of experience in skills architecture, talent management, job architecture, workforce development, learning, HR technology, or a related field.

- Experience designing or significantly enhancing enterprise skills frameworks, taxonomies, or role-based skills models.

- Experience translating business and workforce requirements into scalable skills solutions.

- Experience facilitating skills discovery and validation with SMEs, HR partners, and business leaders.

- Strong analytical, consulting, program-management, and executive-communication capabilities.

- Experience working across interconnected HR, talent, and learning platforms.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Eightfold, Cornerstone, Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar platforms.
- Experience designing skills taxonomies, proficiency frameworks, and relationships among skills, roles, jobs, and learning content.
- Knowledge of job architecture, competency models, occupational frameworks, and skills-based talent practices.
- Experience with workforce analytics, labor-market intelligence, skills-gap analysis, and executive reporting.
- Experience supporting talent and learning system integrations.
- Proficiency with Power BI, Excel, or related reporting tools.

jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives.

The impact you’ll make

As a GIS Program Manager 4, you will play a key role in enabling the successful engineering, automation, and operationalization of client services solutions, with a strong focus on endpoint security, vulnerability management, and platform reliability. You will help bridge the gap between architecture intent and engineering execution by ensuring solutions are built, integrated, and deployed in a way that is secure, scalable, and operationally sustainable. With particular emphasis on endpoint vulnerability posture, you will contribute to strengthening the organization’s ability to proactively manage risk through automation, integration, and standardized engineering practices. Your impact will be measured by improvements in endpoint compliance, vulnerability remediation effectiveness, automation maturity, and the stability of services transitioning into steady-state operations.

What you’ll do

- Drive engineering execution across endpoint & client services platforms, ensuring solutions are implemented in alignment with architecture standards & operational requirements
- Act as a key contributor in automation & integration, developing & scaling solutions that reduce manual effort and improve consistency in endpoint management & vulnerability remediation
- Partner with security, architecture, and engineering teams to manage and improve endpoint vulnerability posture, including identification, prioritization, remediation, and reporting workflows
- Support the implementation of endpoint security controls, compliance baselines and patch management strategies across global environments
- Ensure integration between endpoint platforms, vulnerability management tools, ITSM systems and reporting capabilities to enable end-to-end visibility & control
- Participate in solution design discussions, providing engineering feasibility input and helping shape designs that are practical, supportable and scalable
- Support service transition activities, ensuring engineering deliverables, automation workflows and operational readiness requirements are in place prior to BAU handoff
- Develop & maintain scripts, automation frameworks and orchestration processes to improve endpoint lifecycle management & vulnerability response times
- Monitor operational performance & vulnerability trends, identifying opportunities to improve automation, standardization and remediation efficiency
- Collaborate with global operations teams to ensure consistent adoption of engineering standards, tooling and processes across regions
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across endpoint engineering, vulnerability management and service operations practices
- Take on ad-hoc duties as and when assigned by the Immediate Supervisor

Who we’re looking for

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 6+ years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, infrastructure engineering, client services, or related technical domains, with hands-on exposure to automation and security/vulnerability management practices
- Hands-on experience in endpoint engineering and management platforms (e.g., Intune, MECM, AVD, or equivalent)
- Strong experience in vulnerability management, patching strategies, and endpoint security controls
- Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python, or equivalent)
- Working knowledge of systems integration, API-based automation, and orchestration tools
- Understanding of ITSM processes, particularly in incident, change, and problem management related to endpoint services
- Experience supporting or contributing to service transition and operational readiness activities
- Ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, and drive improvements in engineering and service performance
- Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering, security, and operations teams

Preferred qualifications

Certifications (preferred) :
- Endpoint / EUC Platforms
- Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (Intune)
- Modern Desktop Administrator or equivalent

- Security & Vulnerability Management
- CompTIA Security+
- Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – Associate level acceptable
- Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or equivalent (nice to have)

jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives.

The impact you’ll make

As a GIS Program Manager 5 within Architecture and Engineering , you will play a critical role in shaping how client services solutions are designed, engineered, integrated, and transitioned into stable operations. This role sits at the intersection of architecture platform design , engineering enablement , and service transition , helping turn approved designs into operationally supportable services.
You will contribute to the development of scalable, supportable, and standards-aligned end-user computing and client services solutions across the global environment. By partnering across architecture, engineering, service design, and operations teams, you will help ensure that solutions are not only strategically well-designed, but also automated where possible, integrated across platforms, and ready for successful transition into business-as-usual operations.
Your impact will be measured by the quality of solution design contributions, the effectiveness of automation and integration outcomes, and the smoothness of end-to-end transition from concept and service design through steady-state service operation.

What you’ll do

- Contribute to architecture platform design activities by translating business, operational, and technical requirements into scalable client services solution designs.
- Serve as a subject matter expert in  engineering, automation, and integration , helping define practical implementation patterns that improve quality, consistency, and operational readiness.
- Partner with service design, global service desk, platform operations, and engineering teams to ensure solutions are designed with  supportability, maintainability, and lifecycle ownership in mind.
- Drive and coordinate  end-to-end transition activities from approved design through implementation, operational readiness, hypercare, and transition to BAU.Help define technical standards, reference patterns, integration points, and guardrails that improve repeatability and reduce design-to-operation friction.
- Support engineering execution across endpoint, platform, automation, and service integration workstreams, ensuring solutions align with approved architecture and operating model expectations.
- Identify opportunities to improve automation, eliminate manual operational overhead, and increase service reliability through better tooling, orchestration, and integration.
- Facilitate alignment across cross-functional stakeholders including architecture, engineering, operations, service owners, and business partners.
- Ensure solution documentation, transition artifacts, support models, and operational acceptance criteria are complete and fit for production handoff.
- Assess delivery and transition risks, drive mitigation plans, and escalate issues that could impact service readiness, user experience, or operational stability.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of service design, engineering, and transition practices across the Architecture and Engineering function.

Who we’re looking for

- We are looking for a technically strong and execution-oriented leader who can operate effectively between architecture and operations. This individual is not required to be a fully independent enterprise or client services architect on day one, but should demonstrate strong readiness to contribute meaningfully to solution architecture, influence engineering direction, and lead successful transitions into operational service.
Typically requires 8–12+ years of relevant experience in end-user computing, client services, infrastructure engineering, or related technical domains, with demonstrated progression in scope, complexity, and cross-functional leadership.

The ideal candidate brings a balanced mix of:
- architecture awareness and structured solution thinking
- hands-on engineering credibility
- strong automation and integration experience
- program leadership across cross-functional teams
- operational understanding of what it takes to transition services successfully into BAU

This person should be comfortable working in ambiguity, translating intent into executable outcomes, and connecting strategic design decisions to practical operational realities.

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
- Significant experience in end-user computing, client services, infrastructure engineering, or service architecture roles.
- Demonstrated experience contributing to solution design across one or more of the following areas: - endpoint engineering
- workplace/platform services
- automation and orchestration
- systems integration
- service transition / operational readiness

- Strong understanding of the relationship between service design, engineering delivery, and service operations .
- Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional programs involving architecture, engineering, support, and operational stakeholders.
- Experience driving automation and integration to improve quality, consistency, and operational efficiency.
- Strong working knowledge of service transition concepts, production readiness, support model design, and BAU handoff practices.
- Ability to develop structured documentation, implementation plans, transition plans, and operational acceptance criteria.
- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

Certifications (preferred)
- Architecture & Cloud
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / Azure DevOps Engineer
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) (if applicable to environment)

- Endpoint / EUC Platforms
- Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (Intune)
- Modern Desktop Administrator / Endpoint Management certifications

- ITIL Foundation (minimum); ITIL Managing Professional preferred
- Certifications aligned to service transition, change management, or service design

- Automation / Integration / DevOps
- Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
- Relevant scripting/automation certifications (e.g., PowerShell, infrastructure-as-code exposure)

- Program & Delivery

- Systems thinking – understands how architecture, engineering, service management, and operations connect across the full service lifecycle.
- Technical depth with pragmatic judgment – can evaluate design tradeoffs and recommend solutions that are strategic yet operationally practical.
- Automation mindset – actively looks for opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate repeatable work.

Working collaboratively, you will identify opportunities, prioritize, and execute production-ready solutions that improve process efficiency, enhance decision-making and strengthen controls.

Digital Transformation is a multi-year enterprise initiative focused on standardizing business processes, creating a digital core, improving data quality, enabling AI-driven insights, and deploying scalable technology platforms across the organization. The Systems Planning organization within Global Order Fulfillment is at the center of Lam’s ability to deliver predictable, scalable, and responsive operations. By bringing together planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics, Systems Planning ensures that customer demand is translated into clear, executable outcomes across the global factory network.

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the primary business owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for all Kinaxis-related activities supporting the Factory Production Planning (FPP) organization. This role is responsible for driving system adoption, process optimization, break-fix resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning effectiveness, data integrity, decision quality, and overall business performance.
Acting as the liaison between Planning, Digital Transformation (DT), IT, and Kinaxis support teams, the SME ensures Kinaxis capabilities align with evolving business requirements and support the delivery of reliable, executable production plans across the global factory network. The role provides leadership in identifying system gaps, prioritizing enhancement opportunities, managing issue resolution, and enabling planners to maximize the value of the Kinaxis platform.

In this role, you will serve as the Kinaxis SME for Factory Production Planning, maximizing the value of the Kinaxis platform through system support, continuous improvement, business-driven reporting and analytics, and cross-functional partnership by:
- Serve as the FPP Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Single Point of Contact (SPOC), providing business ownership, support, and guidance for all Kinaxis-related activities.
- Own the intake, prioritization, communication, and resolution of Kinaxis break-fix issues, partnering with DT, IT, and Kinaxis teams to drive timely resolution and minimize operational disruption.
- Lead continuous improvement (CIP) initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and implementing system enhancements that improve planning quality, automation, efficiency, and user experience.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance Kinaxis reporting and analytics that enable business decision-making, including reports and dashboards for SRF changes, capacity gaps, available-to-promise (ATP), next available slot, schedule adherence, and planning performance.
- Gather and translate business requirements into system solutions, managing the Kinaxis enhancement backlog and ensuring planning processes, business rules, and data are accurately represented within the platform.
- Coordinate testing, validation, training, and deployment of new capabilities while partnering across Planning, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and DT teams to maximize the value of Kinaxis and support predictable planning outcomes.

Who we’re looking for

- Strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and attention to detail.
- Data-driven decision maker with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
- Effective communicator and collaborator who influences and aligns stakeholders across functions and regions.

- Passionate about continuous improvement, standardization, and building scalable planning processes.

- 5+ years of experience in production planning, supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, or related disciplines.
- Demonstrated experience with Kinaxis RapidResponse or equivalent advanced planning systems.
- Strong understanding of production planning, capacity planning, scheduling, MRP, and S&OP processes.
- Experience translating business requirements into system solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Continuous Improvement & Transformation Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

This position is in the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As the Senior Manager of CIP (Continuous Improvement Process), you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for driving continuous improvement strategy, process excellence, and operational transformation across the Salzburg site. In this role, you will partner closely with manufacturing engineering, project management, supply chain, quality, and design engineering to identify improvement opportunities, standardize critical processes, and implement scalable solutions that enhance quality, efficiency, and cost performance. Your leadership through influence, technical depth, and structured problem-solving will be essential as we strengthen operational readiness and support significant business growth.

What you’ll do

- Lead the development, documentation, and continuous improvement of standardized operational processes, policies, work instructions, and control methods across key business functions
- Identify, prioritize, and execute high-impact continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and value stream mapping methodologies
- Champion a culture of continuous improvement across the Salzburg site by driving measurable gains in quality, cycle time, productivity, and cost
- Partner with engineering and operations teams to embed Design for Quality (DFQ), Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFMA), and process discipline into product development and new product introduction (NPI) activities
- Drive the development and standardization of engineering and operational review practices, including stage-gate rigor, process controls, tolerance analysis, and verification approaches where applicable
- Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts to address systemic process issues, eliminate waste, and improve overall business performance
- Establish and strengthen structured change management practices to ensure process and design changes are evaluated, communicated, and implemented effectively
- Define and track KPIs for process performance, operational efficiency, and improvement outcomes aligned with factory and site priorities
- Use data analysis to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities across manufacturing and business processes.
- Facilitate structured root cause analysis and corrective action activities with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve recurring operational and process issues.
- Lead initiatives to improve process stability, reduce variation, and prevent recurrence of non-conformances, inefficiencies, and operational disruptions.
- Implement closed-loop improvement mechanisms with metrics to monitor effectiveness, sustain gains, and drive accountability.
- Act as a subject matter expert in continuous improvement methodologies and coach cross-functional teams on practical application of Lean, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving tools.
- Influence stakeholders across functions to align on priorities, remove barriers, and sustain process improvements.
- Develop training materials, playbooks, and standard approaches that build organizational capability in continuous improvement.
- Foster a culture rooted in accountability, data-driven decision-making, and continuous learning through hands-on leadership and collaboration.
- Collaborate closely with manufacturing engineering, test engineering, design engineering, project management, logistics, and quality to align improvement priorities with operational goals.
- Support business and customer-facing process requirements by ensuring robust documentation, standardization, and readiness for audits, reviews, and operational milestones.

Who we’re looking for

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field). An advanced degree is preferred
- Minimum 10 years of experience leading continuous improvement, operational excellence, manufacturing engineering, or process improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment, preferably in semiconductor capital equipment, high-tech, or precision manufacturing
- Demonstrated success as a senior individual contributor driving cross-functional initiatives through influence, collaboration, and structured execution in a matrixed environment
- Strong knowledge of continuous improvement frameworks, process management disciplines, and operational excellence systems, including Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and structured problem-solving methodologies
- Demonstrated expertise in process standardization, KPI development, performance management, and implementation of sustainable improvement mechanisms across cross-functional operations
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proven experience in root cause analysis, value stream mapping, waste elimination, and data-driven performance improvement
- Proven track record of leading process improvement initiatives with measurable business impact
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills
- Fluency in English required; German language skills are a strong plus

Preferred qualifications

- Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Lean Manufacturing certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise

This position is subject to the Austrian Collective Bargaining Agreement for Employees in the Metal Technology Industry in occupation group H depending on educational background. The impact you’ll make

Strategic demand management is a key interface to the product groups for the BDSO organization.  This role serves as the central point of coordination between Product Groups, BDSO, and GOPs to drive weekly engagement for demand, key P&Ds and float determination and allocation.   The float process and capital systems are tools that the strategic demand manager will use to minimize SRD to MCSD gaps for designated strategic growth products.

What you’ll do

Strategic growth products
- Drive annual alignment for strategic growth product list between PG and BDSO.  Maintain the list throughout year as changes occur.
- Drive weekly engagement meetings for demand forecast and close actions on float creation, management and allocation.
- Publish weekly key product reports (dashboards) on selected products for changes, float management to product group and GOPs partners.
- Use floats and other methods to meet SRD to MCSD gap target for strategic growth products.

Float managememt
- Own float management and operations business process
- Weekly update for float tracker to prevent excursions for inside lead time floats and overall risk mitigation for all floats
- Partner with PG to utilize floats, maintain adherence to float policy, and drive CIP as needed

- Own BDSO team NSR KPI dashboards and needed CIP

jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Global Order Fulfillment - Global Operations
The Systems Planning organization within Global Order Fulfillment is at the center of Lam’s ability to deliver predictable, scalable, and responsive operations. By bringing together planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics, Systems Planning ensures that customer demand is translated into clear, executable outcomes across the global factory network.
The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

The Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the primary business owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for all Kinaxis-related activities supporting the Factory Production Planning (FPP) organization. This role is responsible for driving system adoption, process optimization, break-fix resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning effectiveness, data integrity, decision quality, and overall business performance.
Acting as the liaison between Planning, Digital Transformation (DT), IT, and Kinaxis support teams, the SME ensures Kinaxis capabilities align with evolving business requirements and support the delivery of reliable, executable production plans across the global factory network. The role provides leadership in identifying system gaps, prioritizing enhancement opportunities, managing issue resolution, and enabling planners to maximize the value of the Kinaxis platform.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will serve as the Kinaxis SME for Factory Production Planning, maximizing the value of the Kinaxis platform through system support, continuous improvement, business-driven reporting and analytics, and cross-functional partnership by:
- Serve as the FPP Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Single Point of Contact (SPOC), providing business ownership, support, and guidance for all Kinaxis-related activities.
- Own the intake, prioritization, communication, and resolution of Kinaxis break-fix issues, partnering with DT, IT, and Kinaxis teams to drive timely resolution and minimize operational disruption.
- Lead continuous improvement (CIP) initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and implementing system enhancements that improve planning quality, automation, efficiency, and user experience.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance Kinaxis reporting and analytics that enable business decision-making, including reports and dashboards for SRF changes, capacity gaps, available-to-promise (ATP), next available slot, schedule adherence, and planning performance.
- Gather and translate business requirements into system solutions, managing the Kinaxis enhancement backlog and ensuring planning processes, business rules, and data are accurately represented within the platform.
- Coordinate testing, validation, training, and deployment of new capabilities while partnering across Planning, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and DT teams to maximize the value of Kinaxis and support predictable planning outcomes.

Who we’re looking for

- Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.
- Strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and attention to detail.
- Data-driven decision maker with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
- Effective communicator and collaborator who influences and aligns stakeholders across functions and regions.
- Demonstrates a high level of ownership, accountability, and commitment to execution excellence.
- Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and competing demands.
- Passionate about continuous improvement, standardization, and building scalable planning processes.

The Global Planning & Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Data Operations Analyst at Lam, you will play a pivotal role in enabling organizational efficiency and effectiveness across the Global Planning organization. This role focuses on improving how teams access, manage, interpret, and act on information by strengthening systems capability, analytical maturity, and data-driven operating discipline.

In this role, you will identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, eliminate unnecessary “touches,” and simplify the path from question to answer. Your work will connect process understanding, system knowledge, and analytics capability to create scalable solutions that improve decision speed, data quality, and operational performance.

What you’ll do

•    Improve organizational efficiency by reducing manual data handling, redundant reporting steps, and unnecessary handoffs required to find, validate, or manage critical planning information.
•    Partner with planning, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, and IT stakeholders to identify process and system friction points that slow decision-making or create avoidable work.
•    Translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions, dashboards, reporting standards, and system-enabled workflows that improve access to the right information at the right time.
•    Measure and publish operational performance against established metrics and targets, ensuring insights are accurate, actionable, and connected to business outcomes.
•    Perform gap analysis across planning processes, systems, data flows, and reporting routines to identify root causes of inefficiency and recommend sustainable improvements.
•    Develop risk assessments and decision-support narratives that help leaders understand tradeoffs, dependencies, and opportunities for improved execution.
•    Present data-based, prescriptive, and actionable recommendations to leadership with clear linkage to operational performance, system adoption, and efficiency gains.
•    Drive cross-functional process and capability improvements that standardize work, increase analytical self-service, and reduce reliance on one-off manual intervention.
•    Ensure compliance with analytics standards, data definitions, governance expectations, and reporting best practices.
•    Take ownership of complex cross-functional efforts, coordinating stakeholders and advancing work to completion.

Who we’re looking for

•    Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field.
•    5+ years of experience in operations, business analytics, systems enablement, process improvement, program management, or a similar role.
•    Demonstrated ability to improve business processes through systems, analytics, automation, reporting standardization, or data governance.
•    Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, diagnose process issues, and translate insights into action.
•    Experience with Microsoft Power BI and other analytics, visualization, or data management tools.
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and explain complex information in simple, actionable terms.
•    Demonstrated success working in a fast-paced global environment with cross-functional teams.
•    Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving adoption of new processes, tools, or standards.

Preferred qualifications

•    Systems-minded — understands how processes, data, tools, and people connect, and can identify where better system design can reduce effort and improve outcomes.
•    Analytically strong — can convert large amounts of data into simple, accurate conclusions and practical recommendations.
•    Curious — has a strong desire to understand the root cause of problems and challenge why work is done the way it is.
•    Efficiency-oriented — embraces the detailed work required to deliver high-quality outputs while actively seeking ways to streamline, automate, and reduce manual effort over time.
•    Comfortable in ambiguity — brings clarity, structure, and control to complex or chaotic situations.
•    Self-directed — may not know everything at the start, but can learn quickly, connect the dots, and move work forward independently.
•    Stakeholder-focused — can quickly build trust, understand user pain points, and influence adoption of better tools, standards, and ways of working.
•    Outcome-driven — takes pride in producing work that is reliable, scalable, and meaningfully improves how the organization operates.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

jobs.title: Kinaxis Program Manager
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Global Order Fulfillment - Global Operations
The Systems Planning organization within Global Order Fulfillment is at the center of Lam’s ability to deliver predictable, scalable, and responsive operations. By bringing together planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics, Systems Planning ensures that customer demand is translated into clear, executable outcomes across the global factory network.

The impact you’ll make

The Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the primary business owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for all Kinaxis-related activities supporting the Factory Production Planning (FPP) organization. This role is responsible for driving system adoption, process optimization, break-fix resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning effectiveness, data integrity, decision quality, and overall business performance.
Acting as the liaison between Planning, Digital Transformation (DT), IT, and Kinaxis support teams, the SME ensures Kinaxis capabilities align with evolving business requirements and support the delivery of reliable, executable production plans across the global factory network. The role provides leadership in identifying system gaps, prioritizing enhancement opportunities, managing issue resolution, and enabling planners to maximize the value of the Kinaxis platform.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will serve as the Kinaxis SME for Factory Production Planning, maximizing the value of the Kinaxis platform through system support, continuous improvement, business-driven reporting and analytics, and cross-functional partnership by:
- Serve as the FPP Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Single Point of Contact (SPOC), providing business ownership, support, and guidance for all Kinaxis-related activities.
- Own the intake, prioritization, communication, and resolution of Kinaxis break-fix issues, partnering with DT, IT, and Kinaxis teams to drive timely resolution and minimize operational disruption.
- Lead continuous improvement (CIP) initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and implementing system enhancements that improve planning quality, automation, efficiency, and user experience.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance Kinaxis reporting and analytics that enable business decision-making, including reports and dashboards for SRF changes, capacity gaps, available-to-promise (ATP), next available slot, schedule adherence, and planning performance.
- Gather and translate business requirements into system solutions, managing the Kinaxis enhancement backlog and ensuring planning processes, business rules, and data are accurately represented within the platform.
- Coordinate testing, validation, training, and deployment of new capabilities while partnering across Planning, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and DT teams to maximize the value of Kinaxis and support predictable planning outcomes.

Who we’re looking for

- Strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and attention to detail.

- Effective communicator and collaborator who influences and aligns stakeholders across functions and regions.
- Demonstrates a high level of ownership, accountability, and commitment to execution excellence.
- Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and competing demands.
- Passionate about continuous improvement, standardization, and building scalable planning processes.

- 5+ years of experience in production planning, supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, or related disciplines.

- Strong understanding of production planning, capacity planning, scheduling, MRP, and S&OP processes.
- Experience translating business requirements into system solutions.
- Proven project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
- Experience supporting enterprise system implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager 4
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

At Lam Research, the Factory Support Supply Chain Program/Project Manager is part of the Global Operations Group. This group brings together information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing to drive the engine of Lam’s Global business operations. They help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam’s business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Factory Support Project Manager, you will serve as a crucial link between the manufacturing and supply chain departments. Your role involves consistent interaction with both sectors to minimize shipment risks. This is achieved by ensuring the accuracy of components, their location, quantity, and quality. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in Supply Chain Management while maintaining a close understanding of manufacturing operations. Your contributions will be pivotal in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

What you’ll do

- The candidates most successful in this role are individual contributors, self-starters, that can thrive both independently day-to-day and as a part of collaborative teams as they are a vital part of expediting material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates.
- Analyzing Data: This position requires analyzing data in SAP and internal shortage tools to identify, validate, mitigate, and roll up material risk.
- Supporting Manufacturing and Delivery: Support expediting key material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates. The person will act as an interface to cross-functional teams consisting of manufacturing, order fulfillment, logistics, and engineering to ensure the manufacturing production and customer delivery are met.
- Risk Management: The pivotal function of this job is alarming material risks in advance and escalating on time to prevent shipment risk.
- Collaboration: Requires collaboration with Global Operations team and consisting of Buyers, Commodity, Supplier Business Managers, Manufacturing, Engineering, and leadership to find all possible solutions to mitigate material allocation priority. Develop and deliver clear and concise communications for leadership teams and stakeholders.
- Scenario Planning: Factory support should be capable of scenario planning based on provided forecasted plan to share supplier healthiness and drive root cause action plan for improving internal process to prevent shipment delay.
- Project Management: Manage non-technical, supply chain projects using an internal customer perspective, typically from initiation through delivery. Build solutions that will improve Supply Chain Global Factory Support business processes and support critical business strategies.
- Forecasting and Planning: Provide forecasting, planning and strategic execution support to the supply chain to meet current and future business requirements.
- Develop and monitor risk mitigation strategies and coordinate root cause corrective actions.
- Lead and participate in projects to resolve problems or to support continuous process improvement.
- Develop timely reports and key performance indicators to identify/monitor material delivery challenges.

Who we’re looking for

- Proficient in MS Excel and other standard Office programs (i.e. Outlook, Team, Word, ect.)

- Excellent communication (verbal and written) and negotiation skills.

- Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

- Ability to lead and manage within a cross-functional teams.

- Possess a robust comprehension of manufacturing operations and processes.

- Minimum 8 years of experience in the field of Supply Chain; minimum of 5 years of Supply Chain experience with a bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a master’s degree.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as escalation level/single contact person for multiple commodities material shortages.

- Buyer and/or Order Fulfillment experience.

- Experience in chairing meetings with attendees located in different countries and different level of the organization including executive level.

- SAP experience is preferred.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

This role will have a high-profile presence within the Deposition Product Group (DPG) and will drive measurable improvements in business operations through strong quality program management and sustained execution of strategic quality initiatives. The individual will lead cross-functional quality programs, accelerate 8D cycle-time reduction, improve supplier failure analysis effectiveness, and proactively advance DPG quality execution. This role will directly contribute to multi-million-dollar cost savings that will be reinvested into future growth, product development, and data-driven business decision-making, while reducing customer-visible risk.

What you’ll do

- Lead and sustain DPG quality strategic initiatives, owning execution cadence, milestones, risk management, and measurable outcomes across assigned programs.
- Partner with DPG Quality stakeholders and the analytics team to track and manage key KPIs, quality program critical deliverables, identify trends and gaps, and deliver clear, executive-level reporting.
- Drive alignment across Quality, Engineering, SET, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Suppliers to improve end-to-end DPG quality performance.
- Facilitate and lead cross-functional teams (CFTs) to address systemic quality issues and accelerate the transition from reactive issue management to proactive risk prevention.
- Collaborate with Install & Warranty and Inventory program managers to analyze data trends and patterns, driving targeted improvements in key performance indicators.
- Expand the impact and maturity of Cost of Quality by correlating I&W data, ECOGS, and quality events to identify causal relationships and uncover hidden costs across the network.
- Lead and/or advise on multiple concurrent initiatives, demonstrating strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills in a fast-paced environment.

Who we’re looking for

- Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, or Program Management; Master’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience; PhD with 3+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience and/or PDR experience.
- Semiconductor industry experience required.
- Deep working knowledge of 8D/RCCA methodologies, failure analysis, supplier quality processes, and KPI-driven performance management, with demonstrated ability to manage high-complexity workloads in fast-paced environments.
- Proven ability to define clear problem statements and objectives, develop structured analytical approaches, and execute data-driven analyses to drive decisions and outcomes.
- Strong experience leading cross-functional teams, demonstrating effective leadership, influence, and accountability to deliver results.
- Ability to influence and drive alignment within a fast-paced, matrixed, cross-functional organization.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
- Extensive knowledge of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, statistical analysis, and quality systems.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives simultaneously.
- Working knowledge of Power BI, including dashboard utilization and development.
- Strong executive presence, with the ability to present conclusions, insights, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
- Ownership mindset with a bias for action to drive solutions and positive business outcomes.
- Excellent written and verbal presentation skills, capable of engaging audiences at multiple organizational levels.
- Willingness and ability to benchmark and adapt best practices to continuously improve quality execution.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in semiconductor fabrication, semiconductor equipment operations, or closely related industries is preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to improve and evolve processes and methodologies for capturing, structuring, interpreting, and using data effectively.
- Proven success applying structured problem-solving methodologies and quality tools to resolve complex, multi-variable problems.
- Hands-on experience with structured problem-solving frameworks such as PDCA, DMAIC, and 8D, including practical application of quality tools.

jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Functional Quality Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of supply chain quality. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution, blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to drive systemic part quality improvement across the entire supply chain. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.  In this role, you will directly contribute to engaging with supplier engineers to resolve complex quality issues the lead to overall Lam product quality improvement and cost savings in manufacturing and in install/warranty expenses as a final result.

What you’ll do

- - Provide the primary interface between the field and factory to enable efficient quality resolution for supplier quality problems.
- Take ownership and accountability for the success of resolving these quality issues within the expected performance metrics and delivery meets business requirements on time and within budget.
- Partner with stakeholders to understand process and system requirements and deliver enhancements based on a changing technology landscape.
- Lead Continuous Improvement projects, owning the entire lifecycle from inception to impactful results.
- Perform data collection and statistical analysis, and report results to inform program schedules and deliverables.
- Coach and train supplier engineers in 8D process methodologies, tools, and best practices.
- Influence cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process and inspire alignment.
- Deliver change management for programs that are sustainable and maintains long-term success.
- Successfully navigate multiple projects in a highly matrixed and dynamic environment.
- Leverage AI where applicable to drive efficiency gains within the business process and system.

Who we’re looking for

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 8+ years’ experience; or a PhD with 5+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.
- 8+ years of continuous improvement or technical program management.
- Expert level in structured problem solving (8D) with clear abilities to utilize problem solving tools in highly technical quality problems to reach acceptable outcomes.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams and demonstrating excellent leadership and influence skills to deliver results.
- Demonstrated understanding of program management methodologies, tools, and systems
- Strong supplier management and methodologies to drive systematic quality performance improvement
- Ability to perform in depth data analysis required to visually represent, influence, and resolve complex business processes, systems, and quality problems
- Excellent performer in a highly matrixed environment with competing priorities and schedules
- Demonstrated leadership for cross-functional teams to successful achievement of objectives
- Excellent communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to present to audiences at all levels in the Company.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications
- Experience in or deep knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication, Semiconductor Equipment Operations, or related industries is a plus.
- Expert knowledge in business process and system development, alignment, and implementation for a large organization
- Expert knowledge of Program Management methods and experience in Product Development & Release (PDR) procedures.
- Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.
- Experience in Lean Six Sigma methodology or certification (Green Belt, Black Belt) is a plus.
- Experience with Agile and/or Waterfall project methodologies.
- Expertise with project management software and tools including MS Project, QuickBase, Office Timeline, or equivalent.
- Experience in Change Management methodologies is a plus.

jobs.title: Kinaxis Program Manager
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Global Order Fulfillment - Global Operations
The Systems Planning organization within Global Order Fulfillment is at the center of Lam’s ability to deliver predictable, scalable, and responsive operations. By bringing together planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics, Systems Planning ensures that customer demand is translated into clear, executable outcomes across the global factory network.
The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

The Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the primary business owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for all Kinaxis-related activities supporting the Factory Production Planning (FPP) organization. This role is responsible for driving system adoption, process optimization, break-fix resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning effectiveness, data integrity, decision quality, and overall business performance.
Acting as the liaison between Planning, Digital Transformation (DT), IT, and Kinaxis support teams, the SME ensures Kinaxis capabilities align with evolving business requirements and support the delivery of reliable, executable production plans across the global factory network. The role provides leadership in identifying system gaps, prioritizing enhancement opportunities, managing issue resolution, and enabling planners to maximize the value of the Kinaxis platform.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will serve as the Kinaxis SME for Factory Production Planning, maximizing the value of the Kinaxis platform through system support, continuous improvement, business-driven reporting and analytics, and cross-functional partnership by:
- Serve as the FPP Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Single Point of Contact (SPOC), providing business ownership, support, and guidance for all Kinaxis-related activities.
- Own the intake, prioritization, communication, and resolution of Kinaxis break-fix issues, partnering with DT, IT, and Kinaxis teams to drive timely resolution and minimize operational disruption.
- Lead continuous improvement (CIP) initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and implementing system enhancements that improve planning quality, automation, efficiency, and user experience.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance Kinaxis reporting and analytics that enable business decision-making, including reports and dashboards for SRF changes, capacity gaps, available-to-promise (ATP), next available slot, schedule adherence, and planning performance.
- Gather and translate business requirements into system solutions, managing the Kinaxis enhancement backlog and ensuring planning processes, business rules, and data are accurately represented within the platform.
- Coordinate testing, validation, training, and deployment of new capabilities while partnering across Planning, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and DT teams to maximize the value of Kinaxis and support predictable planning outcomes.

Who we’re looking for

- Strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and attention to detail.
- Data-driven decision maker with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
- Effective communicator and collaborator who influences and aligns stakeholders across functions and regions.
- Demonstrates a high level of ownership, accountability, and commitment to execution excellence.
- Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and competing demands.
- Passionate about continuous improvement, standardization, and building scalable planning processes.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or related field.
- 5+ years of experience in production planning, supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, or related disciplines.
- Demonstrated experience with Kinaxis RapidResponse or equivalent advanced planning systems.
- Strong understanding of production planning, capacity planning, scheduling, MRP, and S&OP processes.
- Experience translating business requirements into system solutions.
- Proven project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
- Experience supporting enterprise system implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.
- APICS / ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification preferred

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager 3
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

At Lam Research, the Factory Support Supply Chain Program/Project Manager is part of the Global Operations Group. This group brings together information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing to drive the engine of Lam’s Global business operations. They help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam’s business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Factory Support Project Manager, you will serve as a crucial link between the manufacturing and supply chain departments. Your role involves consistent interaction with both sectors to minimize shipment risks. This is achieved by ensuring the accuracy of components, their location, quantity, and quality. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in Supply Chain Management while maintaining a close understanding of manufacturing operations. Your contributions will be pivotal in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

What you’ll do

- The candidates most successful in this role are individual contributors, self-starters, that can thrive both independently day-to-day and as a part of collaborative teams as they are a vital part of expediting material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates.
- Analyzing Data: This position requires analyzing data in SAP and internal shortage tools to identify, validate and escalate the risk to Lead/Manager
- Supporting Manufacturing and Delivery: Support expediting key material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates. The person will work as an interface to cross-functional teams consisting of manufacturing, order fulfillment, logistics, and engineering to ensure the manufacturing production and customer delivery are met.
- Collaboration: Requires collaboration with Global Operations team and consisting of Buyers, Commodity, Supplier Business Managers, Manufacturing, Engineering, to find all possible solutions to mitigate material allocation priority.
- Project Management: Manage non-technical, supply chain projects using an internal customer perspective, typically from initiation through delivery. Build solutions that will improve Supply Chain Global Factory Support business processes and support critical business strategies.
- Develop and monitor risk mitigation strategies and coordinate root cause corrective actions.
- Participate in projects to resolve problems or to support continuous process improvement.
- Develop timely reports and key performance indicators to identify/monitor material delivery challenges.

- This role is offered as a 1-year contract ; candidates should be comfortable with a contractual employment arrangement.
- Proficient in MS Excel and other standard Office programs (i.e. Outlook, Team, Word, ect.)

- Strong attention to detail.
- Ability to work within a cross-functional teams.

- SAP experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Compliance & Accountability Program Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

You will be part of the Operations and Quality team within Lam’s Clean Product Line, based at our Villach, Austria site. The team plays a key role in enabling operational excellence, quality performance, and effective management systems across the local organization while connecting closely with Lam’s global network of functions and sites.

The impact you’ll make

As Compliance & Accountability Program Manager, you will drive the accountability framework for Lam’s Villach site and help translate corporate strategies, guidelines, and annual objectives into an effective multi-level, cross-functional operating system.
You will ensure alignment of site-level goals, coordinate performance tracking, and enable structured accountability reviews such as Quarterly Operations Reviews. In addition, you will support compliance with ISO 9001 requirements, Lam corporate policies, and global business processes across the Villach site.
In this role, you will act as a central point of contact for compliance, audit readiness, and management-system effectiveness. You will work closely with local stakeholders, global compliance teams, and key Lam sites around the world to strengthen operational discipline, support continuous improvement, and drive sustainable business performance.

What you’ll do

- Act as the local compliance lead for the Villach site, with focus on ISO 9001 requirements, Lam corporate policies, and global business processes.
- Maintain and continuously improve the Villach site accountability system in alignment with Lam’s Annual Operations Plan.
- Coordinate cross-functional objective setting, performance tracking, and accountability reviews, including Quarterly Operations Reviews.
- Lead and coordinate ISO 9001 and customer audits for the Villach site in close cooperation with Lam’s global Compliance organization.
- Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives related to audit findings, process gaps, and management-system nonconformities.
- Facilitate alignment across organizations and functions to ensure clear ownership, timely execution, and measurable progress against site objectives.
- Prepare and communicate performance insights, audit readiness status, and improvement opportunities to local and global leadership teams.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an engaged and structured Compliance & Accountability Program Manager who is passionate about operational excellence, quality management, and continuous improvement.
The ideal candidate enjoys working in a cross-functional and international environment, can translate strategic priorities into practical execution systems, and is able to influence stakeholders across different levels of the organization.
You should be motivated by the opportunity to improve management systems, strengthen business processes, and help the Villach site successfully adapt to evolving market, technology, customer, and corporate requirements.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration,  or related field with 5+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 3+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience  in quality, operations, compliance, program management, or business process management.
- 3+ years of related experience in project management or program management
- Experience working in an international or matrixed organization.
- Solid understanding of ISO 9001 standards and Quality Management Systems.
- Experience in compliance management, business process management, accountability systems, or operational excellence.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment in a matrix organization.
- Strong analytical skills, including data mining, performance analysis, and deriving actionable conclusions.
- Ability to prepare clear management-level communication, performance summaries, and review materials.
- Fluent English skills required; German language skills are beneficial.
- Quality or continuous-improvement certifications, such as Six Sigma Black Belt, are a plus.

What We're Offering

This position is subject to the Austrian Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) for Employees in the Metal Technology Industry in the occupation group F.  A higher payment is negotiable depending on education, expertise and skills. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year.

jobs.title: Regional Indirect Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Global Indirect Procurement

The impact you’ll make

As Regional Indirect Procurement Sourcing Manager at Lam, you will play a crucial role in developing go-to-market approaches and driving cost competitiveness while managing supplier relationships for indirect goods and services. You are responsible to develop and implement procurement strategies, benchmark suppliers, negotiate agreements, and resolve delivery, cost, and service challenges. Navigating a highly visible and dynamic environment, your strategic expertise in creating and implementing supplier solutions will support the availability, quality, and cost-effectiveness of indirect procurement to maintain Lam's reliability and competitive edge.
This is a highly visible role shaping the procurement agenda for strategic capital projects, from greenfield builds to major site expansions and complex upgrades. You will set direction for how we engage the markets, translate business objectives into sourcing strategies, and ensure projects land on time, on budget, and in compliance—while realizing measurable value in safety, quality, schedule, risk mitigation, and total cost of ownership.
You will partner closely with multiple functions stewarding decisions that influence project economics and lifecycle outcomes. The remit includes Malaysia as primary scope with the potential to support other regions depending on portfolio priorities.

What you’ll do

The self-motivated candidate will:
- Develop procurement strategies and present them to the procurement team leader, then own and drive the aligned strategy.
- Plan, organize, and control business/contracts/negotiations for the strategic acquisition of indirect goods and services.
- Drive supplier contract management, conduct supplier negotiations, and formulate comprehensive supplier management strategies based on global/regional/local business environments.
- Facilitate supplier agreement negotiations, renegotiations, and contract addendums.
- Build a robust supply network that fulfills the capacity required for various indirect procurement needs while ensuring ample capacity to accelerate growth and manage global supply chain challenges.
- Represent indirect procurement management on cross-functional teams that focus on supply challenges and ensure internal/external customer needs are satisfied.
- Work cross-functionally with product, manufacturing, and quality engineers, as well as procurement, finance, and product support teams.
- Define and monitor metrics in line with annual operating plan (AOP) objectives relative to supplier performance to ensure continuous supplier improvement; then drive the team to address and close gaps to meet objectives.
- Regularly evaluate cost and quality performance benchmarks and the risks associated with the preferred supply base selection.
- Develop and apply a strategic procurement plan to define a preferred supplier base for indirect procurement.
- Encourage and coordinate early supplier involvement in new service designs using the suppliers’ expertise to optimize quality, cost, and serviceability.

Key Responsibilities:
- Strategic Sourcing: Develop and execute sourcing strategies for indirect categories such as IT, HR, construction management, facilities, lab equipment and professional services.
- Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, and manage suppliers to ensure quality, cost-effectiveness, and reliability.
- Contract Negotiation: Negotiate long-term and blanket contracts with suppliers, ensuring favorable terms and conditions.
- Spend Analysis: Conduct thorough spend analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities and improve procurement efficiency.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand their requirements and ensure alignment with procurement strategies.
- Continuous Improvement: Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes.
- Risk Management: Assess and mitigate risks associated with supplier relationships and procurement activities.
- Reporting: Prepare and present regular reports on procurement activities, savings, and performance metrics.

Who we’re looking for

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA preferred.
- Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or related area with a focus on indirect categories

Preferred qualifications

Skills:
- Strong negotiation and contract management skills.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Proficiency in eProcurement and eSourcing tools.
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Certifications: Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPM, or PMP are highly desirable.

Preferred Attributes:
- Leadership: Demonstrated personal leadership skills with the ability to influence and drive change.
- Innovation: Creative thinker with the ability to develop innovative sourcing solutions.
- Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of procurement.
- Extensive experience in indirect procurement within a complex, multinational environment.
- Deep category knowledge of Indirect Procurement Categories, including market trends, innovations, and supplier landscape.
- Strong proficiency across the end-to-end procurement process.
- Fluent negotiation skills and confidence in managing high-value, high-impact supplier relationships.
- Solid understanding of legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements in a global setting.
- Strategic mindset paired with strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and decision-making skills.
- Fluent English is a must; additional languages are an asset.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

As Senior Sourcing Manager, Lead the techno-commercial strategy for the Cables commodity by integrating engineering insight, supplier capability assessment, cost modelling, and commercial negotiation to enable scalable, reliable, and cost-competitive sourcing solutions. The role is accountable for influencing design decisions early, aligning sourcing strategy with technology roadmaps, developing supplier ecosystems, mitigating lifecycle risks, and delivering measurable business value across cost, quality, lead time, and supply resilience.

What you’ll do

- Define and execute the techno-commercial sourcing strategy for the Cables commodity, aligned with product, engineering, cost, and supply chain roadmaps.
- Partner with Engineering during early design stages to influence specifications, material choices, manufacturability, availability, and cost competitiveness.
- Translate technical requirements into supplier selection, sourcing decisions, commercial models, and long-term commodity strategies.
