The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

We have an exciting opportunity in the Mechatronics commodity to be able to support Lam’s growth. This position is part of the Global Supply Chain Management (GSCM) organization. In this position, you, as a Supplier Business Manager, play a vital role in managing Mechatronics Suppliers to ensure timely deliveries of parts to Lam Factories and Remote Factories. You are the key interface to the supplier’s operations and own their performance to Lam, ensuring the suppliers meet targets for key performance indicators. Your  experience in Supplier Contracts & Price Negotiations for Mechatronics, Machining & Sheet Metal is a must.

The candidate will represent the Supply Chain on cross-functional teams with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Supplier Quality Engineers. Candidate should be a result-driven, self-starter possessing strong interpersonal skills with a strong focus on supporting customers. This individual should also possess the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment, to adapt to changing priorities and work independently in a close-knit team setting.

The candidate will define & monitor metrics in line with AOP (annual operating plan) objectives relative to supplier performance against these expectations to ensure continuous improvement; then drive team to address and close gaps to meet objectives.

What you’ll do

- Define metrics and monitor supplier performance against established scorecards and expectations to ensure continuous supplier improvement and sustainability. Regularly evaluate performance benchmarks, and the risks associated with the preferred supply base selection.
- Continuously work on process improvement to deploy & develop best known methods related to procurement, inventory control (e.g., JIT, Kanban, min/max, consignment) & manufacturing strategies, at times in partnership with Strategic Commodity Managers.
- Motivate and drive the improvement of the suppliers’ manufacturing processes to ensure product quality, cost, and on-time-delivery.
- Have knowledge of supply chain management business processes and proper governance controls for factory management would be added advantage.
- Establish goals with supplier to ensure material delivery meets forecasted demand.
- Represent supplier business management on a cross-functional commodity teams that focuses on supply challenges, and to ensure internal/external customer needs are satisfied.
- Work with engineering and the supplier to resolve complex problems to ensure on time delivery of critical material to support customer and company requirements.
- Develop presentations, white papers, and process flow charts to support continuous process improvement projects.
- Work with suppliers to monitor product costs preventing negative Part Price Variance and supporting cost reduction efforts.

Who we’re looking for

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain management, or applied sciences with 8 years of experience; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a Ph.D with 3 years.
- At least 5 years of working in the Semiconductor Equipment Industry Experience preferred
- Familiarity with semiconductors, electrical equipment, or high-technology supply chain management practices, standards, and organizations.
- Strong business acumen, verbal and written communication skills, and ability to communicate effectively with various levels and roles throughout the organization.
- Proven experience of strong analytical and problem-solving skills with history of successful resolution.
- Experience in Supplier Contracts & Price Negotiations for Mechatronics, Machining & Sheet Metal is a must.

Preferred qualifications

Reporting to the HR Director, the successful candidate will be the key member of HRBP team. The ideal incumbent is expected to be a strategic partner with strong operational mindset and experienced in implementing global policies and practices within a local context. And someone who is experienced with HR COE model, savvy in partnership with Global COE and HR operations leaders to meet business needs within SEA region.

What you’ll do

- Partner with the HRBP leader and local stakeholders to understand the company’s strategy and translate organization capability needs into human resource initiatives
- Play a key contributor in delivering the annual HR initiatives and business driven

- Prior experience in MNC matrixed organization and HRBP role in partnering with business leaders to deliver results through human resource initiatives
- Capable of handling multiple projects, prioritizing and acting with a sense of urgency

jobs.title: NPI HVM Direct Program Manager
jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

The NPI (New Product Introduction) HVM Direct Program Manager will drive sourcing newly designed parts that support our product roadmap directly at our HVM suppliers. This program enables us to lock in better product margins early and source parts closer to our HVM manufacturing sites. The Program Manager (PM) will interface with purchasing, should-cost engineering, sourcing engineers, and regional Supplier Business Managers to optimize the process throughput and outcomes. Clear communication, effective problem solving, negotiating, E2E sourcing process knowledge and a high standard of excellence are essential skills to be successful in this role.
The HVM Direct program works in alignment with our standard Rapid Prototype Manufacturing (RPM) process to source initial designs for a myriad of uses (lab upgrades, Pilot mfg, customer upgrades, etc). These processes provide a strategic advantage for Lam to iterate designs quickly and win new customer business in a very competitive semiconductor market.

What you’ll do

- Translate high-level objectives into actionable strategies and tasks
- Cross-functionally develop metrics & tools to drive delivery and cost savings objectives
- Develop relationships with Lam’s Asia supply base
- Develop knowledge of Lam’s procurement processes & workflows
- Identify risks & opportunities around supplier costs, capacity, delivery performance
- Apply systemic problem solving to resolve internal process gaps
- Coach Supplier Business Managers & Sourcing Engineers on NPI sourcing processes and supplier negotiations
- Present monthly & quarterly performance to executive level audience
- Serve as a resource to buyers for sourcing and process questions
- SPOC for escalations regarding HVM Direct supply base for US based customers
- Develop training and assist in onboarding for new HVM Direct suppliers
- Develop broad-based knowledge of multiple commodities
- Build relationships with cross-functional stakeholders to develop process improvements

Who we’re looking for

- BA, BS/BSE level degree in business, supply chain, engineering, materials science, logistics, or related technical discipline
- Solid analytical and written/oral communication skills with ability to communicate cross-functionally across all levels of the organization
- High-level proficiency in planning, creating and delivering executive-level presentations
- Ability to travel to international supplier sites and after-hours meetings with global team members
- 8+ years supply chain management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Industrial Engineering Advanced Degree
- Previous work experience in commodity management, procurement, contracting, materials management, operations management
- Models effective verbal and written communications, anticipates questions and presents options
- Project Management / Team Lead experience
- Lean six sigma experience
- Understanding of operational processes and interdependencies
- Ability to learn new technologies and manufacturing processes (aptitude/proficiency)

- Customer and results focused, utilizing creative thinking and strong problem-solving capabilities
- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and keep up in a fast-paced environment
